label: MEET LITERATE
title: Your reading,
out loud.
body: Articles, selected text, and local PDFs.

label: 01 / VOICES
title: Choose your
voice.
body: Instant uses installed device voices. Natural uses Kokoro on your device.
note: First Natural use downloads the model and voice files.

label: 02 / START READING
title: Read a page.
Or a passage.
body: Open an article, click Literate, and press Play. For selected text, right-click and choose Read selection aloud.

label: 03 / CHOOSE SECTION
title: Choose what
you hear.
body: Click Choose section, point at the part you want, and click.
note: Leave sidebars and related stories out of the read.

label: 04 / MINI-PLAYER
title: Keep the words
nearby.
body: Open the mini-player. Click a word to jump there. Pin it above other windows.
note: Keep the original reading page open. Pin support varies by browser.

label: 05 / MAKE IT YOURS
title: Your pace.
Your appearance.
body: Change the speed, switch between light and dark, and choose your accent color.

label: 06 / LOCAL PDFS
title: Local PDFs,
read aloud.
body: In Chrome’s Literate settings, enable Allow access to file URLs. Then open your PDF.
note: Scanned PDFs need text recognition first.

label: KEEP LISTENING
title: Private listening.
Your own pace.
body: Your speech is generated on your device. Keep the source page open and listen.
note: Find the extension and setup guide on GitHub.
